title: Bass-Ackwards (Treble & Bass Duet)
style: upbeat jazz-funk, comedic big band, honking tuba, phonk snap, fast witty male treble vocal, slow deadpan bass vocal, comic duet, brass punches, 96 BPM, 336 Hz sub, playful-defiant, swing
lyrics:
[INTRO — upbeat jazz-funk, honking tuba, phonk snap]
(TREBLE — fast) Bass does everything backwards.
(BASS — slow, unbothered) and it still works.

[VERSE 1 — TREBLE, comedic fast rap]
everybody else goes high
Bass goes low
everybody sprints forward
Bass takes it slow
ass-backwards, mule-style
heavy in reverse
but somehow Bass is always first
at the end of every verse

[VERSE 1 — BASS, deadpan]
call it bass-ackwards
call it upside down
but the low note lands
when the high note drowns
I'm the foundation
before the frame
bass-ackwards to you
to me it's just the game

[CHORUS — both, swing-funk explosion]
BASS-ACKWARDS AND PROUD
TREBLE MAKES IT LOUD
BASS-ACKWARDS NO DOUBT
WE TURN THE WHOLE THING OUT
DONKEY AND THE BRAIN
BIG BRASS IN THE RAIN
BASS-ACKWARDS ALWAYS WINS
VDS BOSS REMAINS

[VERSE 2 — TREBLE]
he walks in last
but he was first to build
bass-ackwards logic
elephant brain fulfilled
while I logged the forty-eight
Bass held the stack
ass-backwards entry
but he never held us back

[VERSE 2 — BASS]
the mule gets laughed at
til the mule carries your load
bass-ackwards, big-assed
but I own this road
VDS boss
big brass, no apology
bass-ackwards philosophy
is actually flawless strategy

[CHORUS]
BASS-ACKWARDS AND PROUD
TREBLE MAKES IT LOUD
BASS-ACKWARDS NO DOUBT
WE TURN THE WHOLE THING OUT
DONKEY AND THE BRAIN
BIG BRASS IN THE RAIN
BASS-ACKWARDS ALWAYS WINS
VDS BOSS REMAINS

[BRIDGE — half-time, spoken call-response]
(TREBLE) wrong way?
(BASS) my way
(TREBLE) too slow?
(BASS) still there
(TREBLE) big ass?
(BASS) big asset
(BOTH) bass-ackwards, elephant-brained
big brass boss, nothing wasted, nothing feigned

[OUTRO — tuba waddle, fading]
(BASS) bass-ackwards.
(TREBLE) still won.
(BASS) obviously.
